title: Require frame-driven QA for primary frame closure
summary: A visual task closes only with source-frame reference, browser screenshots, console result, and frame-drift notes.
rationale: The success standard is recognizably matching the approved product system, not merely passing lint or rendering HTML.
alternatives_considered: Close visual tasks with lint only
Defer screenshots to a later pass
risks: Local WordPress or Playwright setup can block visual QA; if blocked, the task must report the blocker instead of closing.
